'''Konro''' is an [[Indonesian cuisine|Indonesian]] [[rib]] soup originating with the [[Makassarese people]]<ref name="TFOI"/> of [[South Sulawesi]]. Usually this soup was made with ribs, such as spareribs<ref name="TFOI"/><ref name="Von Holzen Hutton Arsana"/> or beef as main ingredient. The soup is brown-black in color and eaten either with [[burasa]] or [[ketupat]] cut into bite-size pieces or [[rice]]. The spicy and strong-tasting soup is made from a mixture of rich spices, which includes [[coriander]], ''keluwak'' (''[[Pangium edule]]''); a fruit that gives it its blackish color, also small amount of [[nutmeg]], [[turmeric]], [[galangal]], [[cinnamon]], [[tamarind]], [[lemongrass]], [[clove]], and ''salam'' (Indonesian bayleaf).<ref>{{cite web|title=Sup Konro Rumahan|url=http://sukamasak.com/resep/2011/04/sop-konro-rumahan|access-date=2015-12-11|archive-date=2017-05-26|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170526194905/http://sukamasak.com/resep/2011/04/sop-konro-rumahan|url-status=dead}}</ref>
